intuition_en: 5-hour return skewness: measures asymmetry of hourly returns over 5 bars. Positive skew = occasional large up moves.
intuition_zh: 5小时收益偏度：衡量5根K线小时收益的不对称性。正偏度=偶发大涨。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Conditional direction: positive skew may be preferred (lottery-like) or penalized (unreliable), depending on model.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 条件方向：正偏度可能被偏好（类似彩票）或被惩罚（不可靠），取决于模型。
known_limitations_en: Very short window (5 bars) makes skewness estimate unstable. Direction requires diagnostics.
known_limitations_zh: 极短窗口（5根K线）使偏度估计不稳定。方向需诊断。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 6 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
horizon_notes_zh: 回溯窗口：6根K线。评价覆盖1h/4h/24h/72h视野。
status_explanation_en: Status: DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE. Diagnostic probe — not yet promoted to active signal.

review_subreason_zh: 方向语义需复核；不要人工预设正负方向。
review_subreason_en: Direction semantics need review; do not hard-code a positive/negative sign.
ml_gate_reason_zh: 可进机器学习，但让模型学习符号，人工方向不作为约束。
